nazwa: Wydział Prawa i Administracji, Uniwersytet Szczeciński
nazwa_en: Faculty of Law and Administration, University of Szczecin
opis: Profil importów WPiA (v50). Szkice planów robi parser plan-bm (scripts/us/wpia-pdf.mjs) i wysyła je do kolejki nauka_import_szkic_automat; ten sam profil działa dla PDF-u wgranego ręcznie (szkic AI).

plan.polecenie:
Each item is ONE class in the weekly timetable of one year of study (one cell of the grid, a cell may hold two classes one under another). Day columns: PONIEDZIAŁEK … PIĄTEK; d = weekday: 0 Monday … 4 Friday.
grupa = the year group code given in the task (e.g. PRAWO1); tydzien = oba.
od/do = the class time written in the cell ("godz. 8.15 - 10.45" → 8:15 / 10:45), ignore one-off exceptions ("zajęcia dn. 24.XI trwają 1 godz. …") and put them into n.
pl = the full course name; short codes are explained in the timetable: "WP 8" = classes of the course marked [WP], group 8; workshops LTS, SRzS, OCiEN are explained in the legend.
k = W (wykład), CW (ćwiczenia, warsztaty, lektorat), K (konwersatorium), S (seminarium), LAB, X (other).
pg = "<course name>:<group number>" when the class is for one group only ("WP 8" → "Wstęp do prawoznawstwa:8", "LTS gr. 1" → "Legal Tech start:1"), else "".
p = teachers as printed; r = room as printed ("s. 118 al. Piastów 40b").
daty = dates from "w terminach: 4.XI, 25.XI …" as YYYY-MM-DD (October–December 2026, January–February 2027), [] when "co tydzień".
en = "", g = "", n = notes (exceptions, UWAGA) or "".
